verdict.rationale: Kong ships multiple official CLIs — decK for declarative API Lifecycle Automation/APIOps and Inso CLI for Insomnia automation in CI/CD — both well documented for scripted, automatable use suited to AI-native/agentic workflows. Missing for 10: explicit agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., natural-language CLI commands, agent SDK bindings) and independent/hands-on validation beyond vendor docs.
